walkthroughs.title: One Turn of the Heartbeat
walkthroughs.description: Follow one question from the big picture to an agreed design and back into the docs.
walkthroughs.author: agent

steps.title: Start at the top
steps.what: A question or an idea starts at the system context: who uses the system, and what surrounds it.
steps.why: Agreeing on the top level first keeps the detail from drifting.

nodes.label:
Big Picture First
Context, then containers, then flows

steps.title: Zoom in a level at a time
steps.what: From the context to the containers, then to the flows and components the question is about.
steps.why: The agent asks the bigger questions before the detailed ones.

nodes.label:
Big Picture First
Context, then containers, then flows

steps.title: Answer by showing
steps.what: The agent presents the diagram that holds the answer and lights the path with emphasis or a walkthrough.
steps.why: A lit path on a familiar picture is quicker to check than a paragraph.

nodes.label:
Answer by Showing
The diagram with the path lit

steps.title: The person selects and comments
steps.what: The person clicks the parts they mean and leaves comments on them, then sends the comments to the agent.

steps.title: The agent revises the picture
steps.what: The agent changes the diagram, replies to each comment and resolves it. The page redraws and names the change.
steps.why: Wrong ideas are cheap to fix while they are still a picture.

nodes.label:
Design Together, Live
The agent revises the picture

steps.title: Agree on the picture
steps.what: When the picture looks right, it is the agreement: what will be built, drawn before any code.

steps.title: Code and docs change together
steps.what: The code follows the agreed picture, and the same change updates the diagrams and notes in Git.
steps.why: Docs that change with the code stay worth answering from.

nodes.label:
Living Knowledge Base
Docs change with the code

steps.title: The next answer starts here
steps.what: The next question starts from the kept diagrams, not from a blank page or a long chat.

nodes.label:

Docs change with the code
